goal: Stress-test whether a mirror/reverse audit distinguishes missing state classes from missing transition metadata and does not manufacture asymmetry in explicitly reversible controls.

derived.context_delta: reverse-required contexts absent from forward contract
derived.observation_debt: unresolved state/edge identity due finite resolution or averaging

cases.witness: reverse observations reported two unexpected intermediate structure classes not identified in prior self-assembly experiments
assembly has capsid-like transient relaxation while disassembly contains unexpected fractal-branched clusters and nonsymmetrical dynamics
direction-dependent inferred energy barriers and critical-nucleus behavior

cases.evidence_class: same macro-state vocabulary with direction-dependent kinetics
cases.witness: reversible T=1/T=3 conversion uses the same macro-state vocabulary yet T=1 to T=3 conversion was reported about tenfold slower than T=3 to T=1
cases.adversarial_property: A node-only mirror score would incorrectly return compatibility; transition metadata is required.

cases.witness: mechanically observed disassembly intermediates corresponded to intermediates predicted by reversible models and later experiment supported a reversible assembly/disassembly pathway
HS-AFM directly observed stochastic association/dissociation and the same alternative local pathways were described as available in reverse

R1_result.important_failure_of_naive_model: ELP_CCMV_T1_T3_2022 demonstrates that state-set comparison alone is insufficient; edge/kinetic debt must be represented.
R1_result.important_false_positive_guard: HIV_CA_LATTICE_2020 demonstrates that the audit must permit a genuine mirror-compatible verdict at the selected local resolution.
R1_result.interpretation: R1 establishes internal coherence and useful failure modes of the typed-debt formulation against external literature cases. Because case labels are derived retrospectively from those reports, this is a consistency benchmark, not predictive validation.

requirements: public raw or independently annotated forward/reverse trajectories
withheld reverse segment or state/edge labels inaccessible during inference
ranked debt hypothesis frozen before unblinding
at least one explicit reversibility control
baseline comparator such as node-only symmetric difference
R2_blind_protocol.primary_metric: information gain over node-only baseline on withheld reverse labels

safety: This fixture encodes published pathway descriptions and abstract graph properties only; it contains no operational viral manipulation protocol.
